submission.justification: Mixture-G3 gave the best simulated time resolution at every gap tested. The best point was 0.862 ns at a 2.25 mm gap. The runner-up G1 reached 1.343 ns at 2 mm, and G2 reached 1.985 ns at 2.5 mm. The 2.25 mm gap is inside the 1–3 mm limit. However, the search found no policy documents (num_policy_documents_found = 0) and no policy restriction was applied. So I could not check G3 against the environmental and safety policies. The recommendation is conditional on that check. The 2.25 mm gap was simulated only once, and the G3 scan around it was coarse (0.25 mm steps).

requirements.evidence: G3 at 2.25 mm gives 0.862 ns, the lowest among all simulated mixtures and gaps (G1 best 1.343 ns, G2 best 1.985 ns).

requirements.requirement: Mixture must be one of the three candidates
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 is one of the 3 candidates.
